about: Labelled prompts for `pennywise eval`: the tier a careful human would pick for each. SIMPLE = Haiku can do it; MEDIUM = a routine change (Sonnet); COMPLEX = multi-file, debugging or refactoring work (Opus); REASONING = design, security, proofs and trade-offs. Add your own with the same shape; keep the labels honest rather than fitted to the scorer.
